label: TP
reason: Assessed Alert 1 (java/xss): False Positive. User input flows to fileName but is sanitized via ESAPI.encodeForHTML before printing to the response writer, preventing XSS. Assessed Alert 2 (java/path-injection): True Positive. User input flows from getQueryString -> param -> bar -> fileName -> new File(fileName) without sanitization, enabling path traversal risks. Overall label is TP due to the confirmed path injection vulnerability.

evidence.note: XSS sink: User input is written to response.getWriter() but wrapped in ESAPI.encodeForHTML, mitigating the vulnerability.
Path Injection sink: User input (bar) is concatenated into fileName and passed to new File(fileName) without sanitization, allowing path traversal.
